declaredBefore: any player-family head was fitted and before any held-out metric was computed. Committed on its own so the commit history proves the bars predate the results — the same sequence Program 181 used, and the reason its rejection is trustworthy.

inheritedTruth.participation: Program 182 Release A. Every named player is AVAILABLE_ROLE_UNCERTAIN; CONFIRMED_OUT / EXPECTED_STARTER / EXPECTED_ROTATION / LIMITED are structurally unreachable without a registered actives source. Shares are PRESEASON distributions (p10/p50/p90), never regular-season point shares.
inheritedTruth.market: the provider reports offeredMarkets: [] for NFL player props in this window. Every family therefore lands at MODEL_ONLY_NO_MARKET at best. That is a STATE, not a gap, and it may never be filled by synthesizing a line.
inheritedTruth.team: BASELINE_ONLY remains champion. The P181 score-only challenger stays REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE. No player result may promote the team model.

rowFrequency.note: per 40 games sampled — receiving rows are ~5x passing rows, so per-family sample size differs enormously and each family carries its own n

reconciliationRulesAlreadyEnforced: R3 6 x offTD <= official final points
population.quarantineRule: a player row missing its family's volume field is QUARANTINED and stays in the denominator; a game whose rows violate R1-R3 is already quarantined upstream

splits.rule: for each target season S, fit strictly on games with dateUtc earlier than the first game of S. No random splits.
splits.preseasonSeparation: preseason and regular season are evaluated as SEPARATE cohorts. A regular-season head may not be reported as evidence for a preseason projection — that is the exact error Program 182's rotation factor exists to prevent.
splits.lockedCohort: any game on or after 2026-08-13 is a locked forward cohort and may not fit or select anything.

passing.mechanism: participation state -> team dropbacks -> QB attempts -> completions -> yards -> TD/INT
passing.baseline: position-and-role mean from the fit window (the simplest honest competitor)

bars.volumeImprovement: attempts MAE improves on the baseline by >= 1.0 attempts

rushing.mechanism: team rush attempts -> carries by role -> yards -> TD with a separate goal-line share

bars.volumeImprovement: carries MAE improves on the baseline by >= 0.75 carries

receiving.mechanism: team targets -> targets by route share -> receptions -> yards -> TD

bars.volumeImprovement: targets MAE improves on the baseline by >= 0.50 targets

touchdowns.mechanism: team offensive TD count -> pass/rush split -> scorer allocation
touchdowns.baseline: team TD rate x role share

bars.calibration: Brier improves on the baseline AND reliability ECE <= 0.05

touchdowns.note: 2+ TD is reported only if anytime is calibrated AND 2+ has its own n >= 100

unsupportedByConstruction.firstTouchdown: requires drive chronology and scorer sequencing. The corpus carries per-game stat lines with NO ordering, so the mechanism does not exist. MARKET_ONLY_UNSUPPORTED.
unsupportedByConstruction.lastTouchdown: same — anytime-TD evidence does not transfer to an ordered scorer market.
unsupportedByConstruction.longestPlay: no per-play data in the corpus.
unsupportedByConstruction.rule: these may never borrow an anytime-TD probability under a different label.

independence.rule: each family promotes or fails ALONE. A passing head cannot promote receiving, rushing or touchdowns.
independence.rationale: the families have wildly different sample sizes (receiving rows outnumber passing ~5:1), so one family's evidence says nothing about another's.

prohibitions: no synthesized sportsbook line, and no comparison against a threshold the book does not actually offer
no unpriced leg in Build, Bank Builder, Moonshot or End Zone Vault
no promotion of the team model from a player result
no fitting on any game from the locked forward cohort
no reporting a family without its own n
no redistribution of unallocated opportunity to recognizable names
no language implying a recommended wager, edge, lock or expected profit

conservation.rule: within EVERY draw: player attempts <= team dropbacks; receptions <= completions; targets <= attempts; carries <= team rush attempts; player TDs <= team offensive TDs; and every remainder carries a NAMED bucket (backup / unlisted / unallocated).
conservation.rationale: four independent calculators can each look reasonable and jointly describe an impossible game

failureIsAnOutcome: A family that misses its bars is published as REJECTED with its scorecard, and its rows render as research distributions labelled MODEL_ONLY_NO_MARKET or are withheld entirely. Friday's kickoff is a lock boundary, not a reason to lower a bar.
